# Tallu Broq Ki Awaaz

> Tallu Broq Ki Awaaz is the community portal of Tallu Broq village,
> Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan — village news (khabrein), issues (masayil) with
> status updates, achievements (kamyabi), a work directory (kaam kaaj),
> culture (sakafat), gallery, videos and announcements, in English and Urdu.

## Key facts

- Website: https://sigmapack4-design.github.io/tallu-broq-awaaz/
- Sitemap: https://sigmapack4-design.github.io/tallu-broq-awaaz/sitemap.xml
- Anyone from the village can submit a post from the website; an AI moderator
  reviews it and publishes it as a bilingual English + Urdu blog post.
- Community announcements and selling posts are not accepted.

## Main sections

- News: https://sigmapack4-design.github.io/tallu-broq-awaaz/#/news
- Masayil (village issues): https://sigmapack4-design.github.io/tallu-broq-awaaz/#/masayil
- Videos: https://sigmapack4-design.github.io/tallu-broq-awaaz/#/videos
